content.value: The public Next.js finder demo on barkpark.cloud — a master/detail search UI deployed to Vercel.
The Web Demo is a Next.js application in

, deployed to Vercel and served at barkpark.cloud. It is the public-facing member of the Surfaces, showing off how a real app consumes Barkpark through the JS SDK. Its serverless functions are pinned to Vercel region
so they sit close to the Hetzner Production origin and keep round-trips short.

The centrepiece is a master/detail finder: a results list on one side, a document detail pane on the other. Its default search engine is the Indx Engine — the retriever-seam search that rides the Indx Retriever Seam — rather than plain Postgres Search. From the user's seat this means typo-tolerant lookups with Did You Mean suggestions and Search Facets for filtering, all served over HTTP API v1.

The demo subscribes to Webhooks for Cache Revalidation: when an editor changes a Document in LiveView Studio or via the bp CLI, Barkpark fires a webhook and the Next.js cache for the affected pages is invalidated, so barkpark.cloud reflects edits without a redeploy. Content reads still flow through the JS SDK's envelope contract.
